name: Investigate Echo Ridge
objectiveText: Kill 10 Kobold Workers , then report back to Marshal McBride .   Kobold Worker slain  ( 10 )

comments.body:
[b]Location:[/b]  Northshire Abbey; 48.41 (To recieve and complete the quest).   Northshire Valley; 51.37 (Kobold Worke[b]rs).

Description:[/b]  Level 3.  Also level 1-2 Kobold Vermin around.  However, there is no proximity aggro here.

[b]Experience:[/b] 250

[b]Reputation:[/b] 110 points with Stormwind

[b]Character:[/b]  Level 3

[b]Version:[/b]  1.8.4

Edited, Fri Dec 23 07:05:23 2005

Continue Quest Text (from Marshal McBride):

"Have you been to the mines? Are you ready to report?"

Complete Quest Text (from Marshal McBride):

"I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine. No good can come of this. Hear, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again. I would like you to go back to the mines one more time..."

Hi all

On This Quest you need to kill 10 [npc=257] ou can find them on north from Northshire Abbey. Quest is gives [npc=197] and return to him, He is located inside Northshire Abbey.

See My Video if need it - https://youtu.be/rFgs8-Ncx60

Thank You
This quest rewards 250 Stormwind reputation as of patch 2.01

This is the same quest as Kobold camp cleanup. So dont worry, it's easy :). Once you have the quest head north from abbey, and most likely you will find Kobold workers at the same place where Kobold vermins were. Kill 10 of those and then return to the Marshal. +100 reputation to stormwind and 390 exp doesnt sound so bad :).
